author: Special to Seacoastonline,
title: Center for Grieving Children opens new Sanford location - NewsBreak
text:
By Special to Seacoastonline, ,
1 days ago SANFORD, Maine — The Center for Grieving Children marked a major milestone this month, welcoming community members into its new Sanford home during an open house at 1209 Main Street .
The event drew local leaders, business owners, partner organizations, families, volunteers, and staff for an evening focused on connection and the Center’s expanding role in the region.
The new location, just a mile from the Center’s former Sanford site, reflects both the organization’s growth and the increasing need for grief‑support services in York County. The Center first opened its Sanford program in 2011; today, it is serving more grieving children and families than ever before.
More: Center for Grieving Children 'gave us the ability to cope,' Kennebunk mom says
Leaders said the move strengthens the Center’s ability to provide a compassionate, welcoming environment for children, teens, and caregivers navigating loss. As demand rises, the organization is also seeking additional volunteer facilitators — trained community members who help guide peer‑support groups and offer a consistent, caring presence to families.
The Center emphasized that volunteers play a crucial role in sustaining its free programs. Those interested in learning more, scheduling a tour, or getting involved can contact the Center at cgc@cgcmaine.org, 207‑775‑5216, or visit www.cgcmaine.org .
This article originally appeared on Portsmouth Herald: Center for Grieving Children opens new Sanford location
